_comment: Music pipeline input (see tools/music/pipeline.py). An entry with only `query` is searched on Wikimedia Commons and candidates are printed. An entry with a chosen `file` (Commons file title) is downloaded, loudness-normalised, trimmed to the Roblox limit and uploaded. An entry with `synth` uploads a generated sting. Entries with `assetId` are already uploaded and skipped.
